name: broll-collateral
description: Remotion B-roll library for CoLateral advertising collateral — ten 5s clips of the product UI floating, shuffling, and scheduling itself, with iOS motion.

scripts.render:all: remotion render FloatingScreens out/floating-screens.mp4 && remotion render CardShuffle out/card-shuffle.mp4 && remotion render DepthDolly out/depth-dolly.mp4 && remotion render PipelineFlow out/pipeline-flow.mp4 && remotion render ClipGridPop out/clip-grid-pop.mp4 && remotion render CalendarFill out/calendar-fill.mp4 && remotion render GlassMetrics out/glass-metrics.mp4 && remotion render WordmarkAmbient out/wordmark-ambient.mp4 && remotion render PhoneShowcase out/phone-showcase.mp4 && remotion render VerticalStack out/vertical-stack.mp4
